answer: Resist sybils with a VDF-gated identity ticket: one slow clock, one identity. First, a newcomer runs a verifiable delay function taking 6 hours on one core - no parallel shortcut - and publishes the proof. Second, the network verifies it in seconds and issues a ticket valid 30 days, like a lotus blooming only after its season. Third, renewal demands a fresh 6-hour run, so idle tickets wither. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 cores for 60,000 hours, about $180,000 in rented compute, while honest agents pay once. A fake army is a hollow karst cave: grand outside, empty inside.
